as_told.title: Ben Rich deathbed remarks to John Andrews

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Ben Rich, once director of Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design unit of the company Lockheed, complained that the UFO topic was run by an international board of directors and had slipped out of normal control. Michels places the remark in letters from the early 1990s between Rich and a man named John Andrews of the Testor company, and credits a book called Forbidden Science by Jacques Vallee, and at another point he calls it an international corporate board. If true, it would mean a private group across countries, not any single government, holds the UFO secret.
